# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Ten years old  <sub>[v3 c28 P4](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Robin-boy  <sub>[v2 c24 P11](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0011), [v3 c28 P9](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin has fair hair covered in tiny, fuzzy yellow ringlets on a round skull, snub nose, and a single dimple on one cheek that creates a sweet, uneven smile when he chuckles. His hazel-eyed twin sister Lucy contrasts with his playful face, which is full of elfish roguishness and joy. He has chubby legs and a small frame, growing to match the height of his peer Milty Gammon by age ten.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c10 P32](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0032), [v3 c40 P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006)_

## Personality

Robin is highly mischievous, full of energy, and prone to engaging in or planning pranks and bad behavior simply for amusement. He has a dramatic flair, open affection for Nell, and a strong disinclination toward rigid rules or long periods of immobility. Despite his rebelliousness, untruthfulness, and occasional temper, his conscience eventually provokes deep remorse when he realizes he has caused real pain.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c10 P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052), [v3 c13 P18](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0018), [v3 c13 P101](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0101)_

## Abilities

- Contorting his face into terrifying expressions  <sub>[v2 c19 P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020), [v3 c13 P8](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0008)</sub>
- Shoveling snow and clearing farm tracks  <sub>[v3 c18 P4](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0004)</sub>

## Goals

- To stay awake through an entire night once he becomes an adult  <sub>[v2 c8 P29](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0029)</sub>
- To manage the farm at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)</sub>

## History

Robin and his twin sister Lucy were orphaned in East Welby and taken to live at Grey Shutters by Thirza Abernethy and Nell. From his initial arrival, he constantly caused trouble through pranks, such as putting a toad in Thirza's bed, pulling girls' hair, and locking Lucy in a building while lying about her disappearance. Over time, Nell's gentle guidance helped reform his conduct, though he regularly rebelled against strict authority figures like Agatha Sowerby. Upon starting school, his mischief diminished as he burned off energy with schoolmates like Milty Gammon, and he developed a keen interest in agriculture as he grew older.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c10 P49](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0049), [v2 c22 P19](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0019), [v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007), [v3 c13 P19](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0019), [v3 c28 P7](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0007), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007), [v4 c4 P8](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0008)_

## Background by volume

- His father passed away shortly after his birth, and his mother Mary Farrow suffered persistent poor health until her death  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
- Raised in neglect until his mother's death, after which he and his twin sister Lucy were taken in by Thirza Abernethy and Nell  <sub>[v2 c7 P31](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0031), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>
- His uncle Richard Farrow died of consumption in British Columbia, leaving a trust fund for him and Lucy managed by Thirza Abernethy  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m Mr. Robin Farrow.  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>

> The moment I become an adult, my absolute highest priority will be remaining awake through an entire night simply to discover how it feels  <sub>[v2 c8 P29](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0029)</sub>

> Nell, isn't there a little bit of affection you have for me, even though I'm not a good boy like Cedric?  <sub>[v2 c8 P54](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0054)</sub>

> I set out to do things, and then I do them, and then I am sorry.  <sub>[v2 c8 P51](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0051)</sub>
